name: mockspec-monorepo
description: Mockup-as-Spec (mockspec) — 목업을 등록하면 단독 실행 기획서 HTML을 만들어 주는 사내 서비스

scripts.build: tsc -b && npm run build -w @mockspec/sdk && npm run build -w @mockspec/extension
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b && npm run typecheck -w @mockspec/sdk && npm run typecheck -w @mockspec/extension
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run fixtures:zip && playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:web: npm run build && npm run fixtures:zip:relative && npm run build -w @mockspec/web && playwright test -c playwright.open-service.config.ts
